displayName: OCI-WSTG07-012: File Upload Attack — Malicious File Type
description:
Detects upload of potentially malicious file types including webshells, executables, and script files

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: file upload attack — malicious file type

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg07_012", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%file%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%upload%') AND "value" > 0
